notes.title: "Fortune Cookie" is officially released!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, welcome to "Fortune Cookie"!

This is a tap-to-play game where you can receive various fortunes (including advice, inspiration, encouragement, proverbs, etc.), and also use the collected cookie pieces within the game to craft mystery boxes that contain special fortune cookies.

These cookies include:

Gourmet Cookies which can unlock 50 photos of delicious foods,
Travel Cookies which can reveal 50 travel photos,
HaoHaoGames Cookies which offer various benefits (currently, there's a chance to obtain more cookie pieces, and in the future, we will periodically run events where game activation codes can be dropped),
Daily Cookies which provide daily insights (unfortunately, just as I was clicking to launch "Fortune Cookie", today's Daily Cookie told me "every failure is an opportunity to learn; today is perfect for reflection." It nearly drive me crazy).

Additionally, in the DLC, you'll find Efficiency Cookies with 50 productivity tips, Health Cookies containing information on 50 nutrients, and some of my personal game development experiences.

So, hurry up and dive into the game!

P.S., entering the game now will instantly reward you with 1,000 cookie pieces. Come and try it out!
